rules.title: Rules
rules.lowestWins: Relay format: two groups play at the same time during a live stream on YouTube and/or TikTok. Runs are played in RTA (Real Time Attack).
rules.finalTime: The group whose last player first defeats the final boss wins.
rules.recommendation: We recommend knowing how to speedrun at least 2 Mega Man X games. If you're unsure, contact us on Discord.
rules.draw: Groups will be formed after November 4, when registration closes.
rules.newRule: After the first elimination phase, a new rule will be announced and will apply from that moment on.
rules.sameTime: Within a group, each participant must play a different game.
rules.differentGames: Each participant can choose any game and category allowed in this tournament. Categories follow the Mega Man Leaderboards rules.
rules.categories: Communicate well within your group: if two players pick the same game, the group will be eliminated automatically.
rules.consolesList: Snes9x 1.51 or newer, Bizhawk, PCSX, PCSX2, Duckstation.
rules.consolesBanned: No RetroArch, no VBA & VBA-core for Bizhawk.
rules.gamesBanned:
No mods and no Legacy Collection.
No IGT for X5 & X6.
No password glitch X1.
